{{Quote|My son, Civius, is working in that bunker over there. They refine a spice known as ryll that some people use as a recreational drug.|[[Olivia Bain]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SCBftS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Smuggle Civius Bain from the Smugglers|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Ryll Smuggler Base''', also known as the '''Ryll Smuggler Bunker''', was a bunker located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the headquarters of the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] smuggling ring of the [[Chirq Council]].

==History==
{{Quote|Who supplies you with ryll?''"<br />"''All I know is that it's smuggled onto Corellia on small ships and unloaded at a bunker near here.|A spacer and [[Vuul Sarlin]]|<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" />}}
The Ryll Smuggler Base was located on the [[Vella plains]], near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the bunker was used by the ryll smuggling ring of the Chirq Council, best known as the Red Circle Gang. The ryll smugglers transported the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] onto Corellia on small ships and unloaded it at the bunker where they refined the spice.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" /> The ryll smuggling ring was led by the underboss [[Ubis Reendorr]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref> The smuggler [[Ladonna Poe]] served as the contact of the ryll smuggling ring with [[Vuul Sarlin]] and his group of spice dealers in Kor Vella.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" /> Other smugglers based in the bunker included [[Jaryn Minoze]] and [[Oret Sturm]].<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" />

[[File:UbisReendorr.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ubis Reendorr]] in the command center of the Ryll Smuggler Base.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the ryll smuggling ring following the increase of spice traffic in Kor Vella. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]] questioned a spice addict known as [[Menchi Lerann]]. The man revealed that he bought his ryll from Vuul Sarlin. The spacer later interrogated Sarlin who was forced to reveal everything he knew about the ryll smuggling ring, including the location of the Ryll Smuggler Base. The CorSec therefore assaulted the bunker. The CorSec forces eliminated many ryll smugglers, including Ladonna Poe, and destroyed several crates of spice. They also discovered the existence of the Red Circle Gang from the smuggler's mainframe.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" />

However, the CorSec operation was suddenly cancelled when the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of Kor Vella [[Deel Draav]] was assassinated. When the investigation demonstrated that the mayor was murdered by the Red Circle Gang, the CorSec focused on the ryll smuggling ring again. CorSec forces raided the Ryll Smuggler Base a second time and eliminated the underboss Ubis Reendorr. Thanks to Reendorr's access code, the CorSec was able to access the [[Red Circle Base]] nearby.<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM" /> The CorSec investigation eventually led to the disbandment of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

Around the same time, a young man by the name [[Civius Bain]] got indebted to the ryll smugglers Jaryn Minoze and Oret Sturm and was forced to work for the smugglers. Civius Bain's mother, [[Olivia Bain]], recruited a spacer who killed Minoze and Sturm in the Ryll Smuggler Base, allowing Civius to escape.<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ryll Smuggler Base appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ryll Smuggler Base was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
